methodology.chronology: Only matches completed before the fixture date were used.
methodology.history: Previous-season plus current-season pre-match results were used so early-season fixtures had short/medium/long samples.
methodology.oppositionAdjustment: Recent GF/GA inputs were adjusted by the average strength of recent opponents.
methodology.leagueNormalization: Away scoring probability was compared with the pre-match league away-team scoring baseline.

limitations: This is the reconstructable quantitative portion of v1.9, not a fully audited v1.9 Core backtest.

Historical 06:00 bookmaker prices, opening-line movement, goalkeeper event metrics, set-piece event metrics, team news, motivation, referee and weather/pitch context were not available in the machine-readable source and were not invented.
The current 35% away-score rule produced zero selections before those unavailable contextual/value gates could matter.
Threshold sensitivity is diagnostic only and is not evidence that a looser threshold should be adopted without a larger out-of-sample test.
